policy: Initial permission is read-only planning. No task is complete without recorded verification; publishing and live-data access require explicit authorization.

tasks.title: Inventory repository and freeze verified toolchain
tasks.scope: Read the real repository, preserve existing work, record the Mac/toolchain/SDK state, and identify proposed versus existing paths.
deliverables: ADR-001 native stack and deployment baseline
tasks.completion_contract: An owner-reviewed plan distinguishes verified facts, unsupported environment checks, and genuinely blocking decisions. No application edits before approval.

tasks.title: Prove capture, geometry, and permission feasibility
tasks.scope: After approval and explicit live-test consent, build a minimal capture spike against a synthetic test desktop and investigate the selected permission/sandbox profile.
tasks.completion_contract: Record real still-capture results, app-window exclusion, a mixed-DPI test or explicit hardware block, and a reasoned choice about non-sandboxed automatic scrolling.

tasks.title: Prove privacy rendering and scroll-matching risks
tasks.scope: Use synthetic images to prototype pre-filter opaque masking and a minimal overlap matcher before investing in UI polish.
tasks.completion_contract: Demonstrate the intended redaction information-dependence test and show both a successful and an intentionally rejected ambiguous stitch; report any unrun code honestly.

tasks.title: Create the approved native project and test entrypoints
tasks.scope: Create or adapt the approved app target, local package targets, shared schemes, formatting configuration, and unsigned CI entrypoints.
tasks.completion_contract: A clean Mac checkout builds the skeleton and runs a real domain test without release credentials. Dependency locks and exact script behavior are documented.

tasks.title: Implement typed geometry and domain contracts
tasks.scope: Implement coordinate-space types, safe transforms, request/revision identity, limits, document values, and explicit state transitions.
tasks.completion_contract: Round-trip, outward mask rounding, invalid-input, overflow, and illegal-transition tests pass without UI dependencies.

tasks.title: Build the menu bar, settings foundation, and shortcuts
tasks.scope: Create the native lifecycle, menu commands, onboarding, user-assigned shortcut recorder, localization foundation, and settings.
tasks.completion_contract: The app launches without intrusive permission prompts, exposes keyboard-accessible commands, reports shortcut registration failure, and starts with no automatic side effects.

tasks.title: Implement the still-capture vertical slice
tasks.scope: Implement ScreenCaptureKit still capture, source choice, overlays, delay/repeat, exclusion, and cancellation through to a simple image preview.
tasks.completion_contract: Real capture works for the declared modes and source geometry, with one active request, no idle stream, no self-overlay contamination, and safe late-callback handling.

tasks.title: Implement bounded local image import
tasks.scope: Implement explicit PNG/JPEG file, paste, and drop-in actions using bounded decoding and canonical image orientation/color.
tasks.completion_contract: Valid imports render; unsafe/unsupported inputs fail before uncontrolled allocation. No clipboard polling, remote fetch, or original-file mutation occurs.

tasks.title: Build the document editor and command undo
tasks.scope: Implement the native canvas, document/view transforms, crop/resize/zoom/pan, selection, and bounded command-based undo.
tasks.completion_contract: Undo/redo and geometry remain correct at all specified zooms, and one gesture produces one bounded undo group.

tasks.title: Add essential annotation tools
tasks.scope: Implement text, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, freehand, highlighter, and numbered-step tools with accessible controls.
tasks.completion_contract: Each supported tool creates/edits/replays deterministically, honors focus/input composition, and has no stub or inaccessible essential action.

tasks.title: Implement secure rendering and redaction
tasks.scope: Implement source-bound masks, output coverage, privacy epochs, effect ordering, and flattened render snapshots. Label cosmetic effects separately.
tasks.completion_contract: All available sink-independent redaction tests pass; changing only covered source pixels cannot alter sanitized rendered pixels. No superficial overlay qualifies.

tasks.title: Implement safe save, clipboard, and drag-out
tasks.scope: Create ShareSnapshot encoding, metadata/type allowlists, explicit export commits, atomic file handling, and file-promise lifetime management.
tasks.completion_contract: Every sink accepts only sanitized snapshot bytes. Failed work preserves existing destinations/clipboard where applicable and never reports false success.

tasks.title: Implement bounded reference pins
tasks.scope: Add visible floating references with lifecycle, opacity/zoom, budget enforcement, and privacy-epoch invalidation.
tasks.completion_contract: Five-pin and budget limits work; pins remain closeable and do not silently intercept unrelated interactions or leak stale exports.

tasks.title: Implement local OCR and QR
tasks.scope: Integrate Vision behind the tested adapter, query supported languages, preserve raw-text semantics, and treat QR payloads as untrusted.
tasks.completion_contract: Recognition works offline in the validated environment, aligns boxes correctly, respects masks/cancellation, and never performs a QR-triggered action automatically.

tasks.title: Qualify the useful 0.1 release candidate
tasks.scope: Review the 0.1 scope, perform baseline accessibility/privacy/performance checks, establish licensing/build docs, and prepare a signed candidate only with the required consent.
tasks.completion_contract: All 0.1 gates pass or the scope is visibly reduced through review. Signing checks are real or marked blocked; public publishing remains a separate action.

tasks.title: Implement manual scrolling capture
tasks.scope: Integrate a bounded user-visible capture stream, frame stability, overlap estimation, confidence gating, seam preview, and partial-result review.
tasks.completion_contract: Known sequences reconstruct correctly; ambiguous matches pause/reject instead of fabricating success. Stop and resource limits remain responsive.

tasks.title: Add separately consented automatic scrolling
tasks.scope: Implement minimal targeted scrolling only within the approved permission/sandbox design, preserving manual fallback.
tasks.completion_contract: No Accessibility request occurs before choosing automatic mode. Target changes stop control; denial keeps manual mode usable. No typing/global event logging is added.

tasks.title: Qualify scrolling compatibility and failure behavior
tasks.scope: Validate supported browsers/native fixtures, fixed bands, lazy reflow, duplicate rows, direction changes, and scroll-modifier failure cases.
tasks.completion_contract: Publish only evidence-backed supported targets. Every corrupted/uncertain case is rejected, paused, or explicitly marked partial; resource tests include final encoding.

tasks.title: Implement loupe, measurements, and sRGB inspection
tasks.scope: Add a nearest-neighbor loupe, labeled pixel/point dimensions, ruler anchors, and canonical sRGB HEX/RGB copy.
tasks.completion_contract: Measurements and colors match declared fixture values independently of editor zoom; imported images never get fabricated screen scaling.

tasks.title: Implement multiple-image composition
tasks.scope: Add image layers, stable transforms, z-order, transparency, side-by-side layout, and source-mask propagation across duplicate asset references.
tasks.completion_contract: Composites preserve aspect ratio, geometry, undo, and masks. Unsupported mappings fail safely before any export.

tasks.title: Add presentation effects and safe magnifiers
tasks.scope: Implement backgrounds/padding/corners/shadows and then spotlight/magnifier, reusing the approved sanitized render graph.
tasks.completion_contract: Every derived effect samples sanitized sources, rejects cycles, matches the preview, and stays within the resource budget.

tasks.title: Finish accessibility, localization, and native interaction
tasks.scope: Audit all completed surfaces for keyboard/VoiceOver use, input methods, adaptive appearance, multi-window focus, and EN/PT-BR strings.
tasks.completion_contract: Essential workflows are usable through the stated accessibility paths. Remaining limitations are disclosed rather than labeled fully accessible.

tasks.title: Qualify resource, lifecycle, and privacy budgets
tasks.scope: Run physical-Mac performance/soak tests and inspect egress, app-controlled persistence, retained objects, diagnostics, and failure boundaries.
tasks.completion_contract: Record p50/p95/sample counts and exact environments. No fabricated hardware results, silent budget changes, live capture archive, or content-bearing logs.

tasks.title: Implement and stage the signed updater
tasks.scope: Integrate a reviewed stable Sparkle build, opt-in update checks, signed archives, compatibility filtering, and an actual staging recovery procedure.
tasks.completion_contract: Invalid updates are rejected, default installs remain offline, and the working app survives failure. No release/update key is exposed to untrusted jobs.

tasks.title: Complete open-source handoff and 1.0 release qualification
tasks.scope: Assemble the reviewed source tag, license/notice inventory, reproducible inputs, SBOM, contributor/security docs, final compatibility matrix, and clean-install evidence.
deliverables: Signed/notarized candidate and artifact hashes when authorized
tasks.completion_contract: The release candidate meets its named scope without fake parity/security claims. The maintainer approves any publish action separately; unrun gates remain visibly unrun.

deferred_scope.title: Local automation and optional on-device writing assistance
